Claw.Inflict Fear: If rolled 8, the target chooses to either be Clawed again or get a Phobia Negative Quirk.

Bite.Blood Fever: The target becomes Silenced (it can't use Abilities).

Passives.Blood Rush:
As soon as the Skinwalker drops to/below 50% HP, it can make a free Move Act and a free Bite (even during other Units' turns).
Then, the other Unit can continue its Turn.

Passives.Shapeshift & Mimickry:
While at least 10 meters away from an observer, the Skinwalker can shapeshift into any animal or person they have seen, and can mimick any voice or sound.
The closer you get to a Skinwalker, the more apparent it seems that the transformation is disfigured and uncanny.

Skinwalker.Behavior:
When dropping to 50% HP, they can run towards the back line of the party and bite them!
If healthy, Gnolls employ tactics like kiting, flanking, etc.
If below 50% HP, Gnolls go wild!
Skinwalker.Monster Data: No tactic, mid HP, no gimmick
